summary: Isolate native session discovery and harness HOME in named instances

schema.detail: No claim or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Native session readers use the selected instance home; native drivers and hooks use the same home.

compatibility.detail: The default instance keeps its existing HOME and native discovery. Named instances use their existing home directory, with checked aliases to existing provider accounts and XDG data.

downtime.detail: Restart an existing named instance daemon to use the isolated discovery root.

manual.detail: Named-instance pi/omp profiles are separate from the login profile; sign in or configure the instance profile as needed. Existing provider account directories are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No session files are copied, moved or deleted. An unexpected native-home alias is rejected rather than read.
